results.name: Australia
results.key_finding: HRW's 25-year offshore-detention report and the 17-18 September enforcement expansion give Australia its first evidence-based score; the published 62.5 was a uniform 3.5 placeholder and BND 4.0 asserted refusal ethics the Nauru arrangement contradicts.

results.name: Progressive
results.key_finding: A federal jury found bad faith and awarded $20m compensatory plus $20m punitive damages on 2026-09-11, with trial evidence of a company-wide profit-share incentive to cut claim payouts; the published 76.3 was an unassessed 4.0 placeholder relying on a 6.0 integration premium.

results.name: Unum Group
results.key_finding: First baseline off a 60.9 vector byte-identical to Hartford, Travelers and MetLife; a 2025 court-approved $14.8m settlement established that Unum's own disability benefits specialists were misclassified and denied overtime, while return-to-work case management holds B2 at 4/5.

results.name: Abu Dhabi
results.key_finding: Positive in-window conduct: an emirate labour court recovered AED 7.8m for 948 workers. It moves BND, ACC and INT off an absolute floor, but every positive figure is government self-reported, so it is routed flag-for-review rather than upgrade.

results.name: Tronox
results.withheld_rule: Section 3e-bis rule 5 (calibration concerns are not one-off proposals); 2026-07-21 Freeport-McMoRan calibration_note precedent
results.key_finding: Measured 32.5 (+13.7) but WITHHELD. The published 18.8 vector is byte-identical to Penn Virginia and Rex Energy, both of which this cycle found to be defunct companies, and the delta matches Freeport-McMoRan's 2026-07-21 +13.7 from the same starting value. Referred for band-wide review of never-assessed Critical Fortune 500 rows.

results.name: China
results.key_finding: Decree No. 841 took effect 2026-09-15 allowing exit bans of up to three years on vague security grounds; A5, B2 and B5 dock to 1, but a single tier-3 source nine days after the decree does not move a founder-approved baseline set 2026-05-18 on China's own conduct.

results.name: West Virginia
results.key_finding: FY2025 child-fatality data is out-of-window, but the state publishing it on 2026-09-21 with named corrective actions is in-window and raises AB3 to 4 and AB4 to 3; the 2026-09-13 disaster-declaration request confirms AC1 at 3 without moving it.

results.name: Djibouti
results.subdim_sidecar_reason: No dimension re-scored; the 2026-08-16 sidecar remains current
results.key_finding: Djibouti kept its border open to nearly 3,000 Yemeni arrivals in a week and its 2017 refugee-inclusion law already scores at EQ1 3/5; the reception is 15%-funded and run by UNHCR and IOM, so no Djiboutian conduct clears an anchor threshold in either direction.

results.name: Kingston
results.key_finding: Double-count risk resolved by attribution: the killing of Amani Malcolm and the protest response are Jamaica Constabulary Force conduct, already scored on the Jamaica row on 2026-09-20. No municipal conduct located. A second fatal shooting and Red Hills Road protest on 2026-09-16 is referred to the next Jamaica cycle.

results.name: Bucharest
results.key_finding: Double-count risk resolved by attribution: the tear gas was used by the national Jandarmeria Romana, already scored on the Romania row on 2026-09-17, and the export ban is a European Commission measure. No Bucharest municipal conduct located.

results.name: Kinshasa
results.key_finding: Double-count risk resolved: nothing differs between the Kinshasa and DR Congo rows on this event. The Police Nationale Congolaise is a national force and the arrests were nationwide; the crackdown is already scored once, on the national row, on 2026-09-17.

results.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
results.key_finding: The supposedly new UN Fact-Finding Mission war-crimes report is a YEAR-STALE claim: the OHCHR and JURIST sources carry 2025/09 paths, the report is A/HRC/60/80 from September 2025, and the 81,000-rapes figure compares to 2024, making it a 2025 count. Two ledger additions recommended.

results.name: Waymo
results.key_finding: Two findings: the incident occurred 2026-09-03, seven days before the window opened (the scan's 2026-09-17 is an aggregator date); and the instrument cannot score it either way because authorities have not detailed how Waymo detected the firearm, so a consent failure and a safety response are equally consistent with the record.

results.name: Boston Dynamics (SPOT demo)
results.key_finding: Re-screen of the 2026-09-17 note on the same evidence. Protests against ICE's intended use are objections to a customer's plans, not conduct by Boston Dynamics, and this row sits under open founder decision D23, so no proposal is filed against it.

results.name: Valencia
results.key_finding: The wildfire response was measured and was proportionate (level-2 activation, 300 personnel, 13 aircraft, UME reinforcement, precautionary evacuation, no civilian casualties) but it was the Generalitat Valenciana's, 70km outside the municipality. The 2026-09-21 DANA hearing is regional too, so both in-window items point in opposite directions and neither is the city's.

results.name: Lithuania
results.key_finding: Outside the instrument, as anticipated. A foreign minister's position on Belarus sanctions is a statement about a third state's conduct; maintaining an existing EU line carries no new institutional cost, so it does not even reach S4. No Lithuanian conduct toward people in its care was located in-window.

results.name: Rio de Janeiro
results.key_finding: The anti-organised-crime pilot was launched by President Lula and is a joint federal, state and municipal programme, so it is not the city's conduct. It would point upward if it were, and screening rule 3 bars positive-direction attribution errors too. Third city row this cycle where policing sits above the municipality; flagged for an index-wide attribution convention.

results.name: Buenos Aires
results.key_finding: A protest is not a finding about a city. The austerity grievance is national, no institutional response was reported, and the only source is iz.ru. Notably the attribution WOULD have worked here, because the Policia de la Ciudad is a city force; the evidence failed instead.

results.name: Penn Virginia
results.key_finding: Not assessable: Penn Virginia was renamed Ranger Oil in 2021 and merged into a Baytex Energy subsidiary in 2023, ceasing to exist as an independent public company. Referred to the entity-identity workstream for a catalogue decision, not a score.

results.name: Rex Energy
results.key_finding: Not assessable: Rex Energy filed Chapter 11 on 2018-05-18 and completed the sale of substantially all assets to PennEnergy Resources for $600.5m on 2018-09-28. Its published vector is byte-identical to Penn Virginia's and to Tronox's.

results.name: Sanchez Energy
results.key_finding: Not assessable under this name: Sanchez Energy emerged from Chapter 11 in 2020 as the privately held Mesquite Energy, with different ownership, management and no public reporting. Assessing it would attribute a score to a company that no longer exists.

count_self_check.note: screening_notes (13) = screening-note (12) + corroborates-existing (1). entities_assessed (8) = proposal-filed (4) + confirmed (3) + withheld (1) and equals last_assessed_stamped (8). entities_reviewed (21) = entities_assessed (8) + entities_screened (13).

ledger_additions_recommended.claim: UN Fact-Finding Mission final report finding war crimes and crimes against humanity in North and South Kivu, read as September 2026
ledger_additions_recommended.verification: OHCHR press release path 2025/09; JURIST path 2025/09; report is A/HRC/60/80 submitted to the Human Rights Council in September 2025. The Commission of Inquiry that continued the mission reports to HRC64 in February-April 2027 and gave only an oral update at HRC63 in September 2026.

ledger_additions_recommended.claim: More than 81,000 rapes documented January to September with a 31.5% year-on-year increase, read as 2026
ledger_additions_recommended.verification: UN News path 2025/10; the 31.5% increase is stated against the same period in 2024, so the count is January-September 2025.

ledger_additions_recommended.claim: Waymo detected a firearm and called police leading to two arrests, read as 2026-09-17
ledger_additions_recommended.verification: San Francisco Chronicle and CBS Bay Area place the incident at about 03:52 on 3 September 2026 in the Richmond District. The 2026-09-17/18 date is the Townhall aggregation's publication date. Seven days before this cycle's window opened; not a year-stale claim, so recorded here as an out-of-window date correction rather than a ledger-class misdating.

calibration_flags_for_coordinator.detail: Penn Virginia (#402, defunct), Rex Energy (#404, defunct) and Tronox (#405, live) publish byte-identical vectors at composite 18.8; Sanchez Energy (#408, defunct under this name) is one step away at 17.2. Tronox measured 32.5 (+13.7), exactly matching Freeport-McMoRan's applied 2026-07-21 move from the same starting value. Requires band-wide review of never-assessed Critical Fortune 500 rows, not isolated upgrades.

Allstate 48.4; The Hartford, Travelers, MetLife and Unum Group all 60.9 on identical vectors; Progressive 76.3; Aflac 92.4. Against assessed peers (State Farm 13.8, Cigna 20.3, Centene 32.8, Humana 35.2) the plateau is implausible. Progressive and Unum are moved here on their own evidence; the other five are not touched and need band-wide review.

Three city rows this cycle (Kingston, Kinshasa, Rio de Janeiro) were flagged on police or security conduct that the municipal entity does not control, and Bucharest on national gendarmerie conduct. This is structural. Coordinator guidance is needed on whether the global-cities index should adopt an explicit attribution convention, annotate affected rows, or score municipalities only on municipal functions.

Bucharest (39.1, six dimensions at 2.5), Valencia (60.9), Lithuania (62.5, vector identical to Australia's pre-assessment value) and Buenos Aires (46.9) are all never-assessed placeholder rows surfaced this cycle. Valencia is the highest priority for a first baseline, given the unresolved DANA accountability process in its region and an Established-band placeholder.

notes: All eight published composites for assessed entities reconstruct exactly under computeCompositeFromDimensions (diff 0.0 in every case), so there are no math-hygiene issues this cycle. Rotation-state writes were restricted to last_assessed and last_change_proposal; composite, band and rank were left at published values for every entity, including the four with pending proposals. No index, entity-record, digest or updates file was written. last_assessed was stamped only for the eight entities with a scored assessment on disk; the thirteen screening notes are recorded on disk but deliberately not stamped, so those rows keep surfacing in rotation.
